_readme: Copy this file to my_area.json, set a name and bbox, and run bash quickstart.sh <name>. The bbox is [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees. Keep it small on a first run: ~0.005 x 0.005 degrees (~400 x 550 m) is a few dozen buildings and finishes in minutes. The survey-layer fields are OPTIONAL: the defaults cover the Queenstown Lakes district (2021 LiDAR, 2026 imagery). For any other part of NZ, find your district's DSM/DEM/imagery layer ids at data.linz.govt.nz (search e.g. 'Wellington LiDAR 1m DSM') and the matching OpenTopography pc-bulk dataset at opentopography.org; building outlines are national and need no change.
name: my_test_area
